first_conquest: This is the first Nightmare you have conquered. It will not be the last.
after_fleeing: Last time, you fled. This time you did not.
You ran from your last Nightmare. You stood in this one.
after_failing: The last Nightmare broke you. This one did not.
You died in your last dream. You learned from it.

again_behaviour.text: Again, you betray your own. It is becoming who you are.
Again, you shield the others. It is becoming who you are.
Again, you court death. One day it will answer.
Again, you reach above your rank.

rose: You have grown since your last Nightmare.
fell: You have done better. The Spell remembers.
same_grade: Neither better nor worse than last time.
again_failed: This is not the first Nightmare to end you.
